title: local-distill --verify-accept keeps the caller's Cargo and rustup homes
goal: compose --verify-accept replaces HOME with a scratch directory, so with CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME unset Cargo looked for its registry under the empty scratch home and every --offline accept command failed on its first crate (seen distilling the 2026-11-11 release candidate: 'no matching package named anyhow'). Pin the caller's toolchain homes (shared immutable caches, AGENTS.md) while keeping the scratch HOME, runtime and secret scrubbing.

results.tests: cargo test -p xtask --bin local-distill: 12 passed, 0 failed (new accept_commands_keep_the_callers_toolchain_homes)
results.effect: compose --verify-accept of 2026-11-11-rc1 got past dependency resolution and ran accept commands (it then failed on the pre-existing CLI snapshot drift fixed by T-CLAUDECLISNAP-1)

limitations: Linux x86_64 4-thread cloud container only; Windows not run.
